name: Question 8
problem:
$x$ is negative **or** rational, **and** $x$ is positive **or** an  integer.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $N(x):$ $x$ is negative

- $R(x):$ $x$ is rational

- $P(x):$ $x$ is positive

- $I(x):$ $x$ is an integer

Question 8
?

x is negative or rational, and x is positive or an integer.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

  • N(x): x is negative

  • R(x): x is rational

  • P(x): x is positive

  • I(x): x is an integer

a
(N∧R)∧(P∧I)
b
(N∨R)∨(P∨I)
c
((N∨R)∧P)∨I
d
(N∨R)∧(P∨I)
e
(N∧R)∨(P∧I)
